 for k in range(256):

  u.mem_write(D+0x7000,palette);u.mem_write(D+BP+6,struct.pack('<H',0x7000));u.mem_write(D+start-1,b'\xa5'*946);u.mem_write(D+0xc4,bytes([flag]));u.mem_write(D+0x327e,cache)
  u.emu_start(0x23304,0x23327,count=10000)
  expected=b''.join(palette[i*3:i*3+3]+b'\1' for i in range(10,246))

  assert u.reg_read(UC_X86_REG_SI)==0x7000+738 and u.reg_read(UC_X86_REG_DI)==BP-50
  assert bytes(u.mem_read(D+0xc4,1))==bytes([flag]) and bytes(u.mem_read(D+0x327e,16))==cache
  assert bytes(u.mem_read(D+0x7000,768))==palette;cases+=1
